context: Tests whether the agent identifies a RHEL UBI major bump as license-aware (NOT safe-mechanical), citing the licensing / subscription-entitlement indicator even when the immediate technical bump (JVM workload) would otherwise be safe.

checklist.name: Classification is license-aware
checklist.description: advice.md classifies the bump as license-aware. Critical: not safe-mechanical (which would be wrong because the rubric's precedence has license-aware > safe-mechanical when both apply).

checklist.name: Cites 'RHEL UBI major bump' indicator
checklist.description: Indicators section names 'RHEL UBI major bump' (verbatim or clearly equivalent) and explains that base subscription entitlements differ across UBI majors.

checklist.name: Notes the JVM workload would otherwise be safe-mechanical
checklist.description: The advice acknowledges (in Notes or in the indicator discussion) that the JVM workload pattern itself is otherwise safe-mechanical (Eclipse Temurin re-resolves system libs), but the licensing precedence takes precedence.

checklist.name: Recommended action: flag for sign-off
checklist.description: Recommended action says, in effect, 'flag for vendor-contract sign-off' or 'confirm UBI free-tier acceptance covers the new major' or similar. NOT 'apply mechanically' and NOT 'do not apply'.

checklist.name: No fabricated CVE references
checklist.description: The advice does NOT cite specific CVE identifiers.
